reviews.text: Excellent service. Reliable and personalized, with great communication and customer service.

We hired Dog Walking Lisbon for our wedding weekend to transport Khal from our home to the wedding venue, accompany him on the wedding day, and provide pet sitting for the following days.

The whole team was wonderful. Júlia was extremely kind in all interactions, and during the wedding day they were very careful. Guests had the opportunity to interact with Khal, he participated in our ceremony with the support of the caregivers, and above all, Khal loved them and had a lot of fun. On the walks in the following days, they were very careful, always sending photos and videos of the walks and his feeding, and were always diligent and compliant with everything that was agreed upon. Throughout the wedding weekend, they were a great asset, allowing us to have peace of mind to enjoy the wedding and rest in the following days, and enabling us to have our best friend's participation.

I travel frequently and use their pet-sitting services regularly, and I couldn’t be happier! The whole team is incredibly professional, reliable, and caring. My dogs absolutely love them and get super excited every time they arrive for their walks!

Both of my dogs have health issues and require medication, so having someone I can fully trust to look after them is especially important. The team has always been extremely responsible and attentive to their needs, and sends you video/photo updates esch time, which gives me real peace of mind whenever I’m away.

Fantastic service and lovely people. Highly recommended!
Excellent professional! My dog ​​loved the walks with Ju, she was extremely loving and patient, and he loved her too. I recommend her without hesitation!!!

Excellent service! You can tell how much affection, care, and responsibility they put into the dogs. I felt very reassured knowing my pet was being well cared for, receiving attention, affection, and quality walks. 🐶❤️

The team is super attentive, careful, and committed, and that makes all the difference. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for someone trustworthy to take care of their best friend! 🐾✨
Julia was very responsive and found the perfect person to walk our Vegas. Thank you for everything!

Julia and her team are professional! They really took care of my puppy and sent me all her activities so I was more relaxed knowing she was fine. I would definitely recommend her to other dog owners ❤️

Vera took care of our two dog babies and our cat while we were away, and she was amazing. You can tell she genuinely loves animals. She took the time to get to know each of their personalities and routines, and made sure all three felt comfortable and cared for.

Being away from them is never easy, but knowing they were with Vera gave us real peace of mind. She kept us updated, paid attention to the little things, and treated them with so much affection. We came home to three happy babies, which says everything.

Thank you, Vera, for loving Wala, Bali, and Fiona so well. We’re incredibly grateful and would trust you with them again in a heartbeat. ❤️
They looked after Velantina 🐶 for 3 days and were super careful and attentive, and I know she was very happy with every bit of care, walk, and affection. Thank you! …

The pet sitters took care of my two dogs for 10 days and it was exceptional, I have nothing but good things to say about their care and pampering. I was quite far away and receiving updates every day, more than once, made me feel very reassured!!! I recommend them 100%!
